author: _DISTRACTION_
body:
Hello,

The Map Development team has adopted a new system for public map acceptances and denials, in an effort to aid community mapmaking.

Three map developers have been chosen to handle map verdicts -- {tag=c29bef37d8e242a9b74604f2df78f374}, {tag=ae5c1e91745b4a6fa33711484ede6957}, and myself. We will be voting upon maps a short time after they are posted in the Map Releases thread, in a private document. The votes will be either a red, green, or yellow, along with some comments. If a map receives 2 or more greens, then the map is accepted and a map developer will post "accepted" on the map's thread. If there are two or more red votes, then the map will be denied, and a map developer will post "denied" on the map's thread, along with the comments which relate to why it was denied.

A few notes:
  • All map developers are able to vote in the acceptance/denial document, but the only ones who are actively expected to vote and make comments are Legoche, Clijmart, and myself.
  • Even if a map is accepted, we may request minor changes to be made to it in order to improve its gameplay or aesthetics.
  • If a map is denied, the mapmaker may make the changes suggested in the denial post and resubmit it.
  • The "quick response" is not a guarantee. While it is in everyone's best interest for maps to be responded to in a timely manner, sometimes events may occur which will delay responses. However, we do not expect this to happen frequently.
  • This does not affect Tournament Edition maps at all; those will still be handled by the Official team.
The map development team would like to give a big thanks to {tag=42b105207c51425292d98b65df108b12} for developing and implementing this system.

Thank you for reading, and have fun making maps!
